study_type: Exploratory follow-up designed after inspection of v3 results; not an independent confirmatory replication
model_selection: Sol and Astra selected for contrasting observed v3 mapping responses; no model-population inference
selection_rule: Seven smallest SHA256(context-v1: + anonymous ID), retained in original relative order; no labels/predictions accessed

conditions.clean: Original 70 clean observations, fresh contemporaneous response
conditions.rotation: Original +1 descriptor/name/unit rotation, numeric order retained
conditions.pair_shuffle: Seeded joint permutation of descriptor-value pairs, semantics preserved
conditions.anonymous: Replace descriptor identity/name/unit by positional field labels; numeric order retained; neutral row-description sentence
conditions.random_mapping: One seeded noncyclic global descriptor derangement, all 52 numeric strings/positions retained
conditions.sample_shuffle: Original clean records, seeded different sample order; scores aligned by ID
conditions.subset_batch: Seven label-independently selected original clean records together
conditions.single_01..07: Same seven clean records, one fresh independent request each

failure_policy: One CLI invocation per scheduled job, no semantic/transport rerun by wrapper. Internal reconnects remain visible. Any invalid response is N/A for the entire request. Resume only never-attempted jobs; interrupted jobs require documented disposition.
scoring_policy: Freeze all terminal records before reading answer labels. Pair by anonymous ID, never by row after sample shuffle. Report available-pair denominator and invalid requests. No repeat pooling or equivalence claims.
contrasts: subset-batch-vs-singleton on the same seven IDs
full-clean-vs-singleton on the same seven IDs
uncertainty: Accuracy Wilson and paired run bootstrap conditional on observed outputs; 10000 resamples seed 20260927. Singleton outcomes from a repeat form a descriptive seven-case panel, not one session.
limitations: Same previously inspected 70 TEP runs; no new generalization evidence
Two selected services from one provider
One random permutation per transformation; no population of permutations
Only seven label-free-selected context probe cases, possibly missing classes
Three fresh sessions do not estimate a stable service variance
Descriptor invariance cannot prove memorization, causal reasoning or independence
